seoTitle: Back as an Official GASQ 2024 Center! - Q-Leap
body:
We are once again and since 2019,Exam Center accredited by the GASQ (Global Association for Software Quality) to give you the ISTQB, IREB, IQBBA and TMMi exams. This accreditation guarantees the quality and international recognition of our training and examination catalog.

GASQ accreditation guarantees you the services of a certified trainer, official course materials and certification exams organized immediately at the end of the training course, either on-site or online.

ISTQB certification, held by over 300,000 people to date, is recognized by all employers, from SMEs to major groups, who carry out software testing.

For more information on our training courses, consult our catalog, or contact our team!
